newsitem.title: UK: UK's MMC confirms Bass report completed.
newsitem.headline: UK's MMC confirms Bass report completed.

text.p: Britain's Monopolies and Mergers Commission confirmed on Monday that its findings on a proposed merger between brewer Bass Plc and Carlsberg-Tetley had gone to trade secretary Ian Lang.
"It's gone over. It looks at the effects on competition after increased concentration in the brewing industry," said an MMC spokeswoman.

Normally, Lang would be expeceted to make a decision on whether to wave the deal through in four to six weeks after delivery of the report, but many industry sources now think it will be the first case to be dealt with by a new incoming Labour government.
Labour is thought to view the deal less favourably than the ruling Conservative Party.
"As far as we are concerned uncertainty is unhelpful, it's already been going on for seven months. A merger is the best solution for Carlsberg Tetley," a Bass spokesman said.
A spokesman for Margaret Beckett, shadow Labour Party trade and industry, said she had declined to comment on the deal.
Labour is widely expected to win the forthcoming election on May 1.
